name: Sentry
description: Read issues, events and stack traces from your Sentry projects.
long_description:
Sentry's hosted server. It lists issues across your projects, reads an event with its stack trace and breadcrumbs, and can hand a failing trace to Seer for an explanation.

It is the connector that pairs best with the code surface: the error and the file that caused it come from two places and get read together.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Sentry in your browser and choose what this chat may reach.

risk.notes: Reaches your Sentry organization. Most tools read; the few that change an issue's state are write_external.
